asked.item: Do I get 50% of every month a monthly Creator referral stays?
Meaning of the Tolt 'Earn 50% on all paid customers' message

verdict.reason: The sentences state directly that commission applies only to the referred customer's first payment, not every recurring payment, which answers the customer's question.

steps.text: No, the 50% commission applies only to the referred customer's first payment, not to every recurring subscription payment.
For example, referring a customer to the Creator plan at $97/month earns $48.50 after the customer's first payment succeeds.
The message "Earn 50% on all paid customers" is generic Tolt text and does not mean you get commission on every recurring payment.
